 Isaiah Stewart (illness) is out for Monday’s matchup with the Wizards.
 Stewart has started two straight in place of Zach Edey (ankle), but the former will sit this one out, while Edey gets a questionable tag. Even if Edey returns, the absence of Stewart should allow Taylor Hendricks to log some additional playing time.

 Zach Edey

 Zach Edey (ankle) is available for Monday’s game against the Grizzlies. 
 Back after a two-game absence, Edey should take his usual place in the Grizzlies’ starting lineup. With Isaiah Stewart (illness) out, Quinten Post will be Edey’s primary backup. 
 Gregory Jackson 
 MEM 
 Small Forward 
 #45 
 According to the Memphis Grizzlies PR official X.com account, GG Jackson suffered a broken left metatarsal in his right foot and will undergo surgery. 
 A timeline for Jackson’s return will be provided following the surgery. In Jackson’s absence, Taylor Hendricks and Jerami Grant (head) should see additional playing time. 
 Isaiah Stewart 
 MEM 
 Forward-Center 
 #28 
 Isaiah Stewart (illness) is questionable for Monday’s game against the Grizzlies. 
 Stewart has started the Grizzlies’ last two games at center, filling in for the injured Zach Edey (ankle). Both are questionable for Monday, as is Quentin Post (concussion). If they all sit, the Grizzlies will likely have to go small, with Taylor Hendricks, Olivier-Maxence Prosper and Kris Murray playing more minutes. 
 Quinten Post 
 MEM 
 Center 
 #41 
 Quentin Post (concussion) is questionable for Monday’s game against the Wizards. 
 Post has missed the Grizzlies’ last three games due to the league’s concussion protocol. Zach Edey (ankle) is also questionable for Monday’s game. As a result, Taylor Hendricks’ playing time has increased, with the former lottery pick playing 29 minutes in Saturday’s win over the Nets. 
 Zach Edey 
 MEM 
 Center 
 #14 
 Zach Edey (ankle) is questionable for Monday’s game against the Wizards. 
 Edey has missed the Grizzlies’ last two games, with Isaiah Stewart replacing him in the starting lineup. Beef Stew, who is also questionable due to an illness, should get another start if Edey can’t play on Monday, provided he’s available. 
 Taylor Hendricks 
 MEM 
 Forward 
 #22 
 Taylor Hendricks provided a boost off the bench with 22 points (9-of-13 FGs), five rebounds and four assists against the Nets on Saturday. 
 With Jerami Grant (head) out and GG Jackson (foot) exiting early, Hendricks took on a larger role, and that role only expanded with Isaiah Stewart in foul trouble. Hendricks ended up setting a new career high for scoring, which helped Memphis secure their second straight win. Hendricks took advantage of the opportunity and could become a bigger part of the Grizzlies’ rotation, though he isn’t a player worth adding off the waiver wire off one good performance. Still, dynasty managers that have been holding on have to be thrilled. 
 Gregory Jackson 
 MEM 
 Small Forward 
 #45 
 GG Jackson (foot) will not return to Saturday’s game against the Nets. 
 Jackson played just three minutes before a foot injury ended his night. Taylor Hendricks should take on extra minutes with both Jackson and Jerami Grant (head) unavailable. 
 Zach Edey 
 MEM 
 Center 
 #14 
 Zach Edey (ankle) has been ruled out against the Nets on Saturday. 
 Edey will miss a second straight game, which should allow Isaiah Stewart to remain in the starting lineup for another. He contributed 12 points, five rebounds and four blocks in Friday’s blowout win over the Pelicans. 
 Jerami Grant 
 MEM 
 Forward 
 #3 
 Jerami Grant (head) has been ruled out against the Nets on Saturday. 
 Grant will be unavailable off the bench for Memphis in this game. He played 26 minutes on Friday and scored 26 minutes. They’ll likely turn to GG Jackson and Taylor Hendricks to make up for Grant’s absence. 
 Isaiah Stewart 
 MEM 
 Forward-Center 
 #28 
 Isaiah Stewart put up 12 points (5-of-7 FGs, 2-of-2 FTs), five rebounds, and four blocks in start against the Pelicans. 
 In his start, he was physical and took advantage of the Pelicans defense. He won’t ever be a high-level fantasy player, but he gets the job done. Zach Edey doesn’t play back to backs at this point, so if the Grizzlies decide to rest him, Stewart can be worth a stream.

 LJ Cryer, Brandin Podziemski, Yaxel Lendeborg, Draymond Green and Al Horford will start against the Pelicans on Monday.
 Cryer and Horford will be moving into the starting unit, with De’Anthony Melton and Will Richard heading to the bench. Cryer is getting his first start of the season after having 20 points, six assists and six three-pointers over his last three games while averaging 14.3 points and 3.7 triples per game during this stretch.
